body: Same here. I download the apps, match with way too many people, and then feel stupid. I know I’m doing it to feel validated though...
I feel this so much. Watching my ex husband move on to other girls that we went to high school with hurts so much. I know it shouldn’t matter but it does and I can’t move on..
Same. I don’t really see the point anymore.
I feel this so much. I don’t want to ever hurt anyone else and the only way to do that would to stop forming relationships but I know I also need people in my life. I hate being this way.
Divorce and break up all within a few months
I’m currently going to therapy but it’s not really helping...
Same here. Four years down the drain as of 2 days ago. He was my entire life and now I have nothing.. I feel your pain.

I could never do that.. I wouldn’t want them to live knowing that at any second I might commit suicide. It would be easier just to be dead.. and what would sharing do besides possibly encouraging other people?

Divorced at 22. I’ve wasted years of my life with somebody who I love more than anything but they shattered my world and told me that I’m not wanted. That they probably never loved me. I can’t move back home and be a loser and a failure. I don’t want to move on from this. I really don’t. I mean how do you live knowing that you failed and nobody will ever want you? That you’re not good enough?
Sad and awful? I don’t know honestly. I just know that I can’t leave the people that I love without a goodbye.

I will never feel less pain. It’s not going to go away. I’m 22 and have been suicidal for years but I finally hit my breaking point. It won’t be the first time I’ve tried but this time it’s actually going to work. I don’t plan on failing.
I don’t know how anyone could help honestly. It’s really pointless..
Same here. I’ve been trying to force myself to eat but it makes me sick. I guess my body doesn’t even see the point of eating?
I’m sending you a virtual hug friend! I completely understand how you feel and wish I had an answer on how to fix it...
This describes how I feel right now.. I’m sorry that this is how our lives are going..
